title: Mystic Alchemist's Study
description: A mystical purple-hued alchemist's laboratory features a large green glass bottle containing a purple-skinned figure reading a glowing book. The scene includes an ornate wooden desk with an open spellbook, a quill, a lit red candle, scattered papers, and shelves filled with glowing potions and herbs. Mystical symbols, hanging scales, and ethereal blue smoke surround the central figure.
prompt: A mystical alchemist laboratory with deep purple walls and curtains, a large ornate green glass bottle in the center containing a purple-skinned mystical figure with glowing hands reading an open book. The figure is surrounded by green ethereal smoke and golden magical runes. In the foreground, a wooden desk holds an open spellbook with purple powder, a peacock feather quill, and a lit red candle. Shelves in the background are filled with glowing green potions and herbs, with hanging scales and mystical symbols above. Dreamy, atmospheric fantasy style.
